2. **Pine Crossing:** your own message, 9 Jun 2026. Their appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so the morning receiver can't book early trucks. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.
3. **Wichita store (please confirm):** your message, 2 Jul 2025, about an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher. That call was in the Zoom room hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours, according to Tobias. Nothing in the channel actually says Wichita is a Marrow store.

The Tulsa hub (2 Jul 2025) isn't on the list because that one is Tansley Parcel, not Marrow.

The 9 Jun thread also says three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker just read "waiting". The channel never names those stores, so there may be more Marrow sites than these. I only looked in #central-team, as you asked.
